patch_description: This crossover retains the stronger one-parameter correlation architecture—collective RY mixing, Möbius CZ connectivity, shared ZZ processing, and readout-aligned CRZ gates—while adding the collective RZ basis layer from the lower-depth parent. The RZ gates reuse the same scalar, so the circuit still has only one distinct circuit parameter and three total trainable parameters including gain and bias. Because the diagonal correlation layer is followed by a shared RZ rotation before the next repeated RY layer, the three tied repetitions alternate noncommuting collective basis changes and correlation processing, increasing the useful one-dimensional feature family without weakening parameter economy.
